thread:
sarah-dev: Hey team — nightly e2e longseq run red on throughput gate. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~260ms on the longseq profile. failing job: https://ci.internal/teams/eng-runtime/jenkins/4821 :frowning:
ci-bot: NIGHTLY: e2e-longseq (job 4821) - FAILED - 1 failing gate (throughput-p95)
devin: I can start a rerun with reduced concurrency to see if it's noise. quick question first — is this the 'longseq-2k' profile or the 'longseq-4k'? logs show 2k but tagging everywhere is messy.
sarah-dev: it's longseq-4k in the job config. the long inputs hit a new kernel path in the runtime.
mike-r: adding notes: profiler sampled high KV-cache miss rate during the run, and we saw a small uptick in context swap count on the GPU hosts. I'll paste the snippet:
```
[runtime] kv_cache_miss_rate=0.18
[host] context_switches=1942 -> 2560
[perf] tokens/sec median=920 -> 610
```
alyssa: @mike-r can you confirm whether the quantized model variant was used for the canary? last deploy changed the default variant mapping.
mike-r: checked — nightly uses q4f by default for the 4k model. the canary earlier this morning used q4f too.
devin: I'll kick off a focused rerun with `--seed=20260317 --concurrency=4 --profile=longseq-4k` and upload artifacts. give me 5 mins.
ci-bot: Triggered rerun: https://ci.internal/teams/eng-runtime/jenkins/4821/?rerun=1 by devin
sarah-dev: also please include `--trace=kv-cache` so we can correlate miss spikes.
devin: rerun finished: looks marginally better but still p95 ~220ms. attaching small excerpt of the stdout:
```
run_id=4821-r1: avg_latency=135ms p95=220ms p99=360ms tokens/sec=640
kv_cache_hits=8234 misses=1950
```
alyssa: hmmm. not a pure noise event. @mike-r can you run a quick kernel selection diff between the last green and this nightly? suspect different kernel chosen for the q4f path at long seqs.
mike-r: already on it. bisect idea: would like to try reverting the runtime patch that touched attention tiling from yesterday (CL 7894). if bisect shows it regresses, we can roll forward with a revert.
sarah-dev: agree. but before revert, can we confirm infra noise? @devops any rolling host patch yesterday? I saw a kernel driver update targeted to the GPU fleet.
ci-bot: DEPLOY: gpu-driver-update-2026-03-16 applied to pool-gpu-highmem at 03:12 UTC
devin: ok that's a suspect. I'll coordinate with infra to repro on a host with the previous driver in a test pool.
alyssa: plan: (1) infra confirm driver diff on failing hosts, (2) mike run kernel-selection diff, (3) devin repro with driver rollback in test pool, (4) if confirmed, bisect runtime CLs with attention tiling revert as a last step. I'll create a follow-up ticket.
sarah-dev: perfect. add me to the ticket and ping when the kernel-selection diff is ready. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
mike-r: sending diff in ~15m. :eyes:
